FAIL_TO_PASS: follow-pattern-parameters: retains side-effect-free code in pattern parameters called from try-statement-blocks
decorator-tree-shaking-2: retain the decorator function if the decorated class is retained
indirect-import-function: parameters of indirect function import should also be tree-shaken
return-function-deoptimization: does not deoptimize call arguments of returned functions by default
nullish-coalescing: supports tree-shaking with nullish-coalescing
nested-this-expressions: properly keep or ignore nested "this"-expressions
deopt-string-concatenation: deoptimize concatenation when used as an expression statement to better support es5-shim
break-statement-labels-switch: supports labels when breaking control flow from a switch statement
side-effects-call-arguments: side-effects in call arguments should be included
return-after-error: tree-shakes entities referenced in a return statement after an error
supports-core-js: supports core-js feature detection (#2869)
unmodified-default-exports-function-argument: passing unbound default export to function cannot rebind it
destructured-known-arguments: tracks known argument values through destructuring
smallest: handles treeshake preset "smallest"
async-function-effects: tracks effects when awaiting thenables
unused-parameters: removes arguments that correspond to unused parameters
tree-shake-curried-functions: Remove side-effect-free curried functions (#1263)
side-effects-this: When a constructor is called with the new keyword, changing its this has no side effects
side-effect-e: accounts for local scopes when tested function purity
side-effect-q: discards effects in conditional expressions with known test values
